exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, instrumental vaginal delivery due to fetal distress, instrumental vaginal delivery due to failure to progress, Cesarean section due to fetal distress, Cesarean section due to failure to progress)
Levator hiatal dimensions (transverse diameter, anteroposterior diameter, hiatal area) at rest, on pelvic floor muscle contraction, and on Valsalva maneuver at 12 and 36 weeks gestation
cohort: 252 nulliparous women with a singleton pregnancy
finding: Smaller levator hiatal dimensions on pelvic floor contraction during the first pregnancy were associated with a subsequent instrumental vaginal delivery or Cesarean section due to failure to progress.
mod_finding: Smaller levator hiatal dimensions on pelvic floor contraction during the first pregnancy were associated with a subsequent instrumental vaginal delivery or Cesarean section due to failure to progress.
